title: lpbot: pools and zones
description: What a run saw when it chose its pool and its ranges.

list.name: experiment
list.label: Experiment
list.query: select distinct experiment from runs order by 1
list.definition: select distinct experiment from runs order by 1

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: select run_id from runs where experiment = '$experiment' order by run_index
list.definition: select run_id from runs where experiment = '$experiment' order by run_index

panels.title: Pool ranking when the run started

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(time) as time, pool, fee * 100 as fee_pct, volume_24h_usd, volume_per_day_usd, depth_1pct_usd, implied_vol_24h * 100 as implied_vol_24h_pct, implied_vol * 100 as implied_vol_pct, excluded
from pool_rank
where run_id = '$run'
order by implied_vol desc nulls last

panels.title: Ranges the run looked at, busiest first

targets.rawSql:
select tick_lower, tick_upper, lookback_days, count(*) as looks, avg(passes_per_day) as passes_per_day, avg(time_in_range) * 100 as time_in_range_pct, avg(return_odds_1d) * 100 as back_within_a_day_pct, max(observed_days) as observed_days
from zone_map
where run_id = '$run'
group by 1, 2, 3
order by passes_per_day desc
limit 300

panels.title: Passes per day of the ranges looked at, through the run

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(time) as time, max(passes_per_day) as busiest, avg(passes_per_day) as average
from zone_map
where run_id = '$run' and lookback_days = (select max(lookback_days) from zone_map where run_id = '$run')
group by 1
order by 1
